description:
ExoFuture is a place where I showcase my project based on the challenge "Identify Earth Locations that Analog the Permanent Moon Base Locations and Mars." 

Even though I may not be heavily skilled yet, I have a dream of winning.

Through this event, I am hoping to acquire and develop my skills as a high schooler. This challenge appealed to me most because of how captivating it sounds and how it can facilitate astronauts in the future.
summary: Project ExoFuture focuses on developing suggestions for analogous sites on Earth for both Mars and the Moon. By producing a website, presentation, and maps to explain my project, comparing terrain and geological features made it possible to act as a tool that helps researchers select realistic environments to simulate testing of vehicles and technologies, and prepare astronauts for future missions
details:
A simple website and PowerPoint slides enable users to explore clear, demonstrative comparison of the analogs with the space body with certain features. The google drive has other information.

I believe that these terrestrial analogs can be my contribution to space exploration and study. Researchers at NASA or any other agencies can benefit from these suggestions and may improve the testing and training process. Of course, further research is required by them as I'm just giving them a brief overview and waiting for them to take the next step. Perhaps, this could lead to learning new information.

This can also benefit students and stimulate them to do their own research, spark their curiosity and help them quickly identify realistic Earth locations for mission testing and training.

As I'm a highschooler and am not well-versed in the world of coding, I used SI to create the website and for assistance with research and drafting. I used google maps for demonstration/visualisation. Google Chrome was used primarily for this challenge. I used a map on atlas book to determine which country I could consider as an analogous site for Mars or the Moon

I considered geological and environmental factors such as rocky terrain, arid conditions, surface structure, temperature/weather, dust storm, etc.

I think my project is creative because of the choice of distinct terrestrial analog sites, considering more factors/conditions than the basic ones, and finally because I focused on finding sites that closely resemble the space body, while making sure the sites weren't or aren't being used for analog test sites by researchers.
